generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A workflow can finish material implementation and green validation but publish no consumable readiness package, or can make a versioned certificate self-stale by binding it to the commit that contains itself.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat the repository head after writing result artifacts as the same identity that the result artifacts must certify, or skip artifact generation when only a connector is available.
trigger_signals: certificate is stored in the candidate branch
material implementation is frozen before result artifacts
stale package from a prior delivery
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Require a direct result-only child whose parent is the certified material head, constrain its changed paths to an explicit allowlist, and fail closed before audit when publication is unavailable.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: The delivery controller must generate and validate readiness artifacts for the frozen material head in every runtime mode and atomically replace stale packages before handing off.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: The audit preflight must validate certificate hashes plus result-only-child parent/allowlist before spending broad independent audit effort.
